planets.name: TOI-5076 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-5076 with a 23.4-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-5076 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-5076. Its orbit and size follow Heidari et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
